105700.name: Wide Road Through the Foothills

north.description: To the north lies Rolling Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies The Rolling Foothills.

west.description: To the west lies Wide Road Through the Foothills.

105700.description:
The wide road ends at this rutted turning-place, where cart wheels have
worn deep grooves into the pale gravel. A leaning milestone, its carving
too weathered to read, stands at the verge. Foothills roll away to the
north and south in folds of dry grass, and the road runs on west toward
the dark bulk of Castle Varok. A cold wind combs the grass without ever
quite dying down.

105701.name: Wide Road Through the Foothills

north.description: To the north lies Rolling Foothills.

east.description: To the east lies Wide Road Through the Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies The Rolling Foothills.

west.description: To the west lies Wide Road Through the Foothills.

105701.description:
A stub of milestone, capped with yellow lichen, is all that remains of
the markers that once lined this stretch of road. The surface is hard-
packed gravel with a crown in the middle, drained by ditches choked with
dead leaves. The grass on both sides is trampled by recent travellers.
The road continues east toward its end and west toward the castle, with
paths off north and south.

105702.name: Entrance to Castle Varok

north.description: To the north lies A Side Path.

east.description: To the east lies Wide Road Through the Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies Along the Castle Wall.

west.description: To the west lies Foyer.

105702.description:
The entrance of Castle Varok is a vaulted gate in a curtain wall of
black stone, its portcullis rusted up and left forever half raised.
Stone faces with chipped features glare down from the lintel, weeping
rainwater. A pair of tall oak doors stand open west into a foyer lit by
candles that never seem to flicker. Paths follow the wall north and
south, and the road runs back east.

105703.name: Foyer

north.description: To the north lies Short Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies Entrance to Castle Varok.

south.description: To the south lies Short Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies The Main Hall.

105703.description:
The foyer is a tall square hall floored with black and white marble, its
tiles dull under a veil of dust. A grand chandelier hangs overhead,
every candle burning with a cold, still flame. Dust sheets cover the
furniture, draped over shapes like slumped mourners. Doors lead north
and south into hallways, the castle's gate lies back east, and an open
archway leads west into the main hall.

105704.name: Short Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Short Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies Foyer.

105704.description:
The hallway is narrow and panelled in dark walnut, its surface furred
with dust. Portraits in gilt frames line the walls, their faces gone
grey and indistinct. A runner of blue carpet is worn through in the
middle. The hallway runs north deeper into the castle and south back to
the foyer.

105705.name: Short Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Lord's State Room.

south.description: To the south lies Short Hallway.

105705.description:
At this end of the hallway a tall pair of double doors, carved with
flowering vines, leads to the lord's state room. A table holds a dead
vase of dry flowers, their petals fallen in a ring. The air is chill and
smells of old roses. The doors stand north, and the hallway returns
south.

105706.name: The Lord's State Room

south.description: To the south lies Short Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Back Hall.

105706.description:
The state room is a long chamber with a vaulted ceiling, where a great
table of black wood stands under a sheet of dust. High-backed chairs,
each carved with a bat-winged crest, line the table, and a tapestry of a
hunt on the wall has faded to brown. Tall windows have been boarded from
within. The door south leads to the hallway, and a smaller door west
leads to the back hall.

extra_descs.tapestry hunt:
The tapestry shows a pale lord on a black horse chasing a stag through a
night forest. The stag, on close inspection, has the face of a man.

105707.name: Short Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Foyer.

south.description: To the south lies Short Hallway.

105707.description:
This hallway is hung with rich but faded tapestries of vineyards and
moonlit orchards. A narrow table holds a tarnished silver candelabrum
whose candles have burned to nubs. The carpet muffles each step, and the
walls seem to hold their breath. The hallway runs north to the foyer and
south toward a closed door.

105708.name: Short Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Short Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies The Lord and Lady's Bedchamber.

105708.description:
Here the hallway ends before a door of black lacquered wood with silver
hinges in the shape of bats. The air is perfumed with an old, cloying
scent of lilies and something sweeter beneath. A mirror in a tall frame
hangs on the wall, but it is covered with a black cloth. The door stands
south, and the hallway runs back north.

105709.name: The Lord and Lady's Bedchamber

north.description: To the north lies Short Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Southern Hallway.

105709.description:
A vast bedchamber, hung in crimson and black, where a canopied bed big
enough for a dozen sleepers rises on a dais. The curtains are drawn, and
a heavy coffin of black stone stands beside the bed with its lid ajar.
Candles gutter in sconces without ever burning down, and the shadows
move a moment after you do. A door west leads to a hallway, and the door
north returns to the corridor.

extra_descs.coffin black stone:
The coffin is hewn from a single block of black stone, its lid carved
with a sleeping figure in a long robe. Faint scratches mar the inside of
the lid.

105710.name: The Main Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Grand Ballroom.

east.description: To the east lies Foyer.

south.description: To the south lies Kitchen.

west.description: To the west lies The Main Hall.

105710.description:
A vast hearth yawns in the wall of this hall, big enough to roast an ox,
its grate cold and swept clean. Hunting trophies stare down with glass
eyes: stags, boars and a great wolf's head. The flagstones ring hollow
underfoot. Archways lead north to the ballroom and east to the foyer, a
passage leads south to the kitchen, and the hall continues west.

105711.name: The Main Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Grand Ballroom.

east.description: To the east lies The Main Hall.

west.description: To the west lies The Base of the Stairwell.

105711.description:
This end of the great hall rises two stories to a beamed roof, where
banners in black and silver hang in rotted ribbons. A long table of dark
oak stands in the middle, laid with plates for a feast that never came.
The air tastes of dust and cold wax. Archways lead north to the ballroom
and east along the hall, and a door west leads to the stairwell.

105712.name: The Grand Ballroom

east.description: To the east lies The Grand Ballroom.

south.description: To the south lies The Main Hall.

105712.description:
The ballroom's polished floor stretches away in a sea of chequered
parquet, scuffed by the passing of many steps though no dust lies here.
High mirrors in gilded frames line the walls, reflecting the pale ghosts
of candle flames. Faint strains of a waltz hang in the air as if
remembered. The ballroom continues east, and the main hall lies south.

105713.name: The Grand Ballroom

south.description: To the south lies The Main Hall.

west.description: To the west lies The Grand Ballroom.

105713.description:
At this end of the ballroom a raised dais holds the stands of a vanished
orchestra, with music sheets yellowing on the stands. Long velvet drapes
hang over tall windows, rotted into rags. The floor is cold and gleams
like dark water. The way south leads to the main hall, and the ballroom
opens west.

105714.name: Back Hall

east.description: To the east lies The Lord's State Room.

west.description: To the west lies Back Hall.

105714.description:
The back hall is a plain servants' passage, whitewashed and bare, though
the whitewash is flaking in great patches. Iron hooks line the walls,
once for lamps. The flagstones are worn into hollows by generations of
hurrying feet. It runs east toward the state room and west to further
passage.

105715.name: Back Hall

east.description: To the east lies Back Hall.

west.description: To the west lies Back Hall.

105715.description:
A long, draughty stretch of the back hall, where cobwebs trail across
the passage like torn lace. A bucket with a rotted bottom lies on its
side, and a mop has stiffened into a grey claw. The silence is complete
except for a drip somewhere. The hall goes on east and west.

105716.name: Back Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Back Exit.

east.description: To the east lies Back Hall.

105716.description:
The back hall bends here toward a small door at its far end, and the
walls close in. A rack of broken lanterns and a heap of dust-covered
sacking fill one corner. The floor is gritty with soot. The hall leads
east back toward the state room, and north to the back exit.

105717.name: The Back Exit

south.description: To the south lies Back Hall.

105717.description:
A small oak door, bound in iron and fastened with rusted bolts, leads
out to a neglected kitchen garden behind the castle. Light leaks through
its cracks in thin lines, and a cold draught whistles at the keyhole. A
broom and a rotted barrel stand by the wall. The only way back lies
south down the hall.

105718.name: Storage

east.description: To the east lies Kitchen.

105718.description:
Sacks of mouldering flour and grain have burst along the walls of this
storeroom, and the floor is crusted with grey meal. Shelves of rope,
candles and spare lanterns stand beneath layers of dust. Rat droppings
dot the boards, and a broken crate spills tarnished cutlery. The only
way out is east to the kitchen.

105719.name: Kitchen

north.description: To the north lies The Main Hall.

south.description: To the south lies Cold Storage.

west.description: To the west lies Storage.

105719.description:
The castle kitchen is a soot-black vault of brick, with iron hooks
overhead and a hearth wide enough to stand in. A long butcher's block,
deeply scored, stands in the middle, and copper pans hang green and dull
from the beams. Nothing has been cooked here for years. The kitchen
opens north to the main hall and west to a storeroom, and a heavy door
south leads to cold storage.

105720.name: Southern Hallway

east.description: To the east lies Southern Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies A Bend in the Hallway.

105720.description:
A worn rug of foreign pattern lies crooked on the floor, and fringes of
cobweb hang from the sconces. Bare patches on the wall show where
paintings have been removed. A faint tune, like a music-box, drifts from
somewhere far off and then stops. The hallway runs east, and bends away
west.

105721.name: Southern Hallway

east.description: To the east lies Southern Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Southern Hallway.

105721.description:
Suits of armour stand in niches along this hallway, each one grey and
silent, their visors lowered. One has fallen and lies in a clatter of
plates beneath its niche. Dust drifts in the air, stirred by your
passing. The hallway goes on east and west.

105722.name: Southern Hallway

east.description: To the east lies The Lord and Lady's Bedchamber.

west.description: To the west lies Southern Hallway.

105722.description:
A long hallway runs along the outer wall of the castle, its windows
shuttered with iron and sealed with cobweb. The floor is a chess-board
of dusty tile. Pale light seeps through the shutters in narrow blades.
The hall leads east to the lord and lady's door and west along the
shuttered wall.

105723.name: A Bend in the Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Western Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies Southern Hallway.

105723.description:
The hallway makes a sharp turn here, and a tall window set into the
angle looks out, through grimy glass, on the dull fields beyond the
wall. A stone bench stands beneath it, its cushions rotted to rags. The
cold is sharper at the corner. The hall leads north into the Western
Hallway and back east.

105724.name: Western Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Western Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies A Bend in the Hallway.

105724.description:
The hall here is lined with doors that open on empty rooms, their hinges
rusted into place. A threadbare carpet runs down the middle, patterned
with faded roses. The ceiling is stained by old leaks in rust-coloured
maps. It runs north toward a heavy door and south to a bend.

105725.name: Western Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Base of the Stairwell.

south.description: To the south lies Western Hallway.

105725.description:
At this end the hallway meets a heavy oak door, banded with iron, and a
lantern bracket on the wall holds only a pool of congealed tallow. The
floor is scored with the scrapes of furniture dragged long ago. A sour
smell of cold ashes hangs in the air. The door north opens on a
stairwell, and the hallway runs back south.

105726.name: The Base of the Stairwell

east.description: To the east lies The Main Hall.

south.description: To the south lies Western Hallway.

up.description: To the up lies Upper Hallway.

105726.description:
A broad stairwell climbs from here in a long curve, its banister carved
with twining vines and its steps worn smooth in the middle. A pool of
dim light falls from a high window, thick with floating dust. A door
south leads to the hallway, an archway leads east into the main hall,
and the steps rise up into darkness.

105727.name: Guest Room

south.description: To the south lies Upper Hallway.

105727.description:
A guest room hung in faded green, its four-poster bed still made with a
counterpane worn thin as paper. The washstand holds a cracked basin, and
a smell of damp wool comes from the wardrobe. A narrow window, nailed
shut, looks out over the dull fields. The only way out is the door
south.

105728.name: Guest Room

west.description: To the west lies Northern End of the Hall.

105728.description:
This guest room is decked in yellow silk gone brown, with a canopy over
the bed that has half collapsed into a heap. A writing desk by the
window holds a dried inkwell and a quill chewed down to a stub. Spiders
have strung the curtains with grey webs. The door west returns to the
hall.

105729.name: Northern End of the Hall

east.description: To the east lies Guest Room.

west.description: To the west lies Upper Hallway.

105729.description:
The hall comes to an end at a blank panelled wall, hung with a single
oval mirror whose silvering is eaten into black lace. A narrow bench
stands under it, and a candle stump sits in a dish. The door east leads
to a guest room, and the hall returns west.

105730.name: Upper Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Guest Room.

east.description: To the east lies Northern End of the Hall.

south.description: To the south lies Upper Hallway.

105730.description:
A tall window of coloured glass shows a saint or a sinner, its panes
cracked, and throws splinters of faded colour on the floor. The carpet
here is stained dark in one long streak. A door north leads to a guest
room, the hall ends east at a landing, and it returns south.

105731.name: Upper Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Upper Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies Guest Room.

south.description: To the south lies Upper Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Guest Room.

105731.description:
Portraits of pale, handsome ancestors hang along the hall here, each
with the same sharp chin and dark eyes, and their gaze seems to follow
you. A table beneath them holds a dish of dust and a stopped clock.
Doors east and west lead to guest rooms. The hall runs north and south.

105732.name: Upper Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Upper Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies Guest Room.

south.description: To the south lies Upper Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Guest Room.

down.description: To the down lies The Base of the Stairwell.

105732.description:
The upper hallway is lit by a long skylight, grimed and cracked, that
lets down a grey, dusty glow. A carpet of faded red runs the length of
the hall, bearing a trail of footprints in the dust. Doors lead east and
west into guest rooms, the hall goes on north and south, and the stairs
lead down.

105733.name: Upper Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Upper Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies Guest Room.

south.description: To the south lies Upper Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Guest Room.

105733.description:
A narrow table in an alcove holds a bust of a stern, hook-nosed man,
whose marble nose has been chipped. The carpet here is rumpled, as if
something heavy was dragged along it. Faint scratches mark the door-
frames, deep as claws. Doors lead east and west to guest rooms, and the
hall runs north and south.

105734.name: Upper Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Upper Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies Guest Room.

south.description: To the south lies Upper Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Guest Room.

105734.description:
A pair of tall pier-glasses face each other across the hall, throwing
endless reflections of dust and darkness down the passage. Their frames
are carved with bats and grapevines. A stuffed owl in a glass dome on
the sill stares out with yellow eyes. Doors lead east and west, and the
hall goes north and south.

extra_descs.pier-glasses glasses mirrors:
The two tall mirrors show the hallway in perfect detail, down to the
dust. No living person who stands before them, however, finds any
reflection of themselves held there for more than a moment.

105735.name: Upper Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Upper Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies Southern End of the Hall.

south.description: To the south lies Guest Room.

105735.description:
The hallway widens here into a small landing, with a window seat looking
out over the foothills through dirty glass. A faded cushion lies on the
seat, scattered with dried flies. The air is stuffy and warm. The hall
runs north, a passage leads east to the end of the hall, and a door
south opens into a guest room.

105736.name: Southern End of the Hall

east.description: To the east lies Guest Room.

west.description: To the west lies Upper Hallway.

105736.description:
The end of the hall is closed by a wall of dark panelling, with a half-
circle table and a vase of long-dead lilies beneath a darkened portrait.
The floor boards creak at every step. A door east leads to a guest room,
and the hall returns west.

105737.name: Guest Room

west.description: To the west lies Southern End of the Hall.

105737.description:
This guest room has a heavy, old-fashioned bed under a canopy of moth-
eaten brocade, and a deep window seat heaped with mouldering cushions. A
round rug, woven in ancient patterns, lies curled at the edges. A faint
scent of incense hangs in the dust. The only way out is the door west.

105738.name: Guest Room

north.description: To the north lies Upper Hallway.

105738.description:
A bare, tidy room with a plain wooden bed, a table and a single chair,
as though someone expected company but never quite prepared the place.
The walls are hung with samplers, the stitching rotted away. The air is
musty. The door north is the only way out.

105739.name: Guest Room

west.description: To the west lies Upper Hallway.

105739.description:
A guest chamber filled with the smell of rotting rose petals, which lie
in drifts across the floor and bed. The wallpaper is printed with
climbing vines and stained with brown water. A cracked porcelain
washbowl sits on a stand. The only way out is the door west to the hall.

105740.name: Guest Room

west.description: To the west lies Upper Hallway.

105740.description:
A modest guest chamber with a curtained bed and a washstand, its
shutters nailed fast. A moth-eaten rug covers the floor, and a mildewed
trunk has been pushed against the wall. Mouldering lavender sachets
scent the air faintly. A worn door at the west wall leads back to the
hall.

105741.name: Guest Room

west.description: To the west lies Upper Hallway.

105741.description:
A cheerless room with walls of bare plaster and a bed of black iron, its
blankets folded with military neatness. A footlocker stands open and
empty at its foot. Cold radiates from the stone as if the room has never
been warmed. The door west opens on the hall.

105742.name: Guest Room

west.description: To the west lies Upper Hallway.

105742.description:
A small room with blue-painted walls, now blistered and peeling, and a
narrow bed with a patchwork quilt. A dressing table stands before a
mirror whose glass is blank with grime. Mouse-chewed books lie in a heap
under the window. The only exit is the door west to the hall.

105743.name: Guest Room

east.description: To the east lies Upper Hallway.

105743.description:
A roomy chamber with a stone fireplace, the grate choked with cold
clinker, and a leather armchair splitting at the seams. The bed hangings
are dark purple and smell of mildew. A tall window is shuttered and
barred. The door east leads back to the hall.

105744.name: Guest Room

east.description: To the east lies Upper Hallway.

105744.description:
This guest room is a tidy bedchamber with a wardrobe thrown open and a
bed whose covers have been pulled aside, as if its sleeper rose
hurriedly. Dust has settled over everything but a clear patch on the
floor. The window is hung with grey lace. The door east leads back to
the upper hall.

105745.name: Guest Room

east.description: To the east lies Upper Hallway.

105745.description:
A guest room whose furniture has been draped with sheets, so that it
resembles a gathering of silent figures in the gloom. Heavy curtains are
drawn across the window, and a cold draught stirs their hems. A smell of
camphor lingers. The door east is the only way out.

105746.name: Guest Room

east.description: To the east lies Upper Hallway.

105746.description:
Scorch marks climb the walls of this guest room, where a fire once raged
and was put out, and the bed is a heap of blackened sticks. Smoke has
stained the ceiling in a dark bloom. The window glass has crazed in the
heat. The only way out is the door east to the hall.

105747.name: Along the Castle Wall

north.description: To the north lies Entrance to Castle Varok.

east.description: To the east lies The Rolling Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies Along the Castle Wall.

105747.description:
The castle's curtain wall towers beside the path, forty feet of black
stone streaked with water-stains and crowned with leaning battlements.
Narrow arrow slits, unlit, gaze out like empty eyes. The turf at its
foot is bare and trodden into a path. The gate lies north, the wall runs
on south, and the hills slope up to the east.

105748.name: The Rolling Foothills

north.description: To the north lies Wide Road Through the Foothills.

east.description: To the east lies The Rolling Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies The Rolling Foothills.

west.description: To the west lies Along the Castle Wall.

105748.description:
Short, wiry grass covers this slope, which leads up toward the grim
walls of the castle. A line of old fence posts, grey and leaning,
marches along the hill toward the stonework. The wide road lies north,
and the wall can be reached by a short walk west. Crows wheel and shout
around the battlements.

105749.name: The Rolling Foothills

north.description: To the north lies Wide Road Through the Foothills.

east.description: To the east lies The Rolling Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies The Rolling Foothills.

west.description: To the west lies The Rolling Foothills.

105749.description:
A rotting wooden gate stands in the grass here, its fence long gone, as
if some farmer meant to shut out the whole hillside. Burdock and teasel
have grown tall around its posts. The road is a short step north, and
the ground falls on south, west and east. A fine drizzle beads in your
hair.

105750.name: The Rolling Foothills

north.description: To the north lies Wide Road Through the Foothills.

east.description: To the east lies The Rolling Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies The Rolling Foothills.

west.description: To the west lies The Rolling Foothills.

105750.description:
A low stone cairn, built by travellers and added to over the years,
stands beside the path in this sheltered fold of the hills. Wild thyme
and yarrow grow among the stones. The road is close at hand to the
north, and the ground rolls on east, west and south. Somewhere a cowbell
clanks, faint and hollow.

105751.name: The Rolling Foothills

north.description: To the north lies Wide Road Through the Foothills.

west.description: To the west lies The Rolling Foothills.

105751.description:
The foothills here are bare and windswept, with a thin carpet of grass
over pale stone and a few stunted rowan trees. Old wagon tracks cut
across the slope from the road to the north. The land drops away to the
west, where a stream bed glints in the hollow. Wind sings thinly in the
rock.

105752.name: Along the Castle Wall

north.description: To the north lies Along the Castle Wall.

east.description: To the east lies The Rolling Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies Along the Castle Wall.

105752.description:
Water has stained the wall in long black streaks beneath each slit, and
a drain-spout carved as a snarling beast spits nothing now. Moss covers
the base and tiny ferns sprout from the mortar. The path follows the
wall north and south, while a way leads east across the hill. The ground
underfoot is wet and strewn with fallen mortar.

105753.name: Along the Castle Wall

north.description: To the north lies Along the Castle Wall.

east.description: To the east lies The Rolling Foothills.

105753.description:
The wall makes a blunt, battered corner here, a great angled buttress of
stone where the foundations are cracked and sagging. Lichen in orange
coins covers the buttress, and high above a lone window slit stares
down. The path runs north along the foot of the wall, and a trail leads
east into the hills.

105754.name: The Rolling Foothills

north.description: To the north lies The Rolling Foothills.

east.description: To the east lies The Rolling Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies The Rolling Foothills.

west.description: To the west lies Along the Castle Wall.

105754.description:
Grass grows thick and tangled between the wall's foot and the open
hillside here, and a hawthorn thicket crowds near a place where the
stones have slumped. A thrush sings from the thorn, bold in the dull
light. Slopes lead north, south and east, and a path runs west to the
foot of the castle wall.

105755.name: The Rolling Foothills

north.description: To the north lies The Rolling Foothills.

east.description: To the east lies The Rolling Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies The Rolling Foothills.

west.description: To the west lies The Rolling Foothills.

105755.description:
A broad, bare hump of hill gives a clear view of Castle Varok's turrets,
dark against the clouds. The turf is scuffed by hooves and sprinkled
with the droppings of deer. Paths run off in every direction across the
crest, north toward the road and south down a long slope. A stiff breeze
plucks at your clothes.

105756.name: The Rolling Foothills

north.description: To the north lies The Rolling Foothills.

east.description: To the east lies The Rolling Foothills.

west.description: To the west lies Along the Castle Wall.

105756.description:
The hillside is strewn with a litter of old building stone, where part
of the castle's outer works was tumbled down by weather and time. Burrow
holes riddle the bank, and the earth around them is scattered with grey
fur. The ground leads north and east, and the castle wall stands close
by to the west.

105757.name: The Rolling Foothills

north.description: To the north lies The Rolling Foothills.

west.description: To the west lies The Rolling Foothills.

105757.description:
The last rise of the foothills on this side ends in a hollow of thistle
and bramble, where the paths peter out. A fallen elm lies across the
hollow, its bark peeled and bleached. The slope climbs north to open
hills, and a trail leads west toward the foot of the castle wall.

105758.name: The Rolling Foothills

north.description: To the north lies The Rolling Foothills.

west.description: To the west lies The Rolling Foothills.

105758.description:
The ground is soft and springy underfoot, thick with moss around a seep
that wets the hillside. Tall rushes grow in a ragged line where the
water gathers, and dragonflies hover over the damp. Slopes climb north
toward the road and fall away west. The air feels heavier here, as
before a storm.

105759.name: A Side Path

north.description: To the north lies A Side Path.

east.description: To the east lies Rolling Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies Entrance to Castle Varok.

105759.description:
A narrow path of trodden earth runs beside the castle's outer wall,
hemmed in by bramble and mallow. The wall rises in rough courses of
black stone, topped with broken battlements. The path leads north toward
a farm and south to the castle entrance, and a gap in the brambles opens
east onto the hills.

105760.name: Rolling Foothills

north.description: To the north lies Rolling Foothills.

east.description: To the east lies Rolling Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies Wide Road Through the Foothills.

west.description: To the west lies A Side Path.

105760.description:
The foothills slope gently down to the wide road here, and the dark top
of the castle's outer wall peeps above the grass. Fox droppings and a
few scattered bones tell of hunting in the night. A side path leads west
into the bracken, and the road lies south. Grey mist gathers in every
dip as the light fades.

105761.name: Rolling Foothills

north.description: To the north lies Rolling Foothills.

east.description: To the east lies Rolling Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies Wide Road Through the Foothills.

west.description: To the west lies Rolling Foothills.

105761.description:
Nettles and dock have colonised the verge where the hill meets the wide
road, and the ground is churned by wheels. A broken cartwheel lies half
buried in the weeds, its spokes rotted to splinters. The road runs close
by to the south, while the slopes stretch away north, east and west. A
blackened fire-ring shows where travellers once camped.

105762.name: Rolling Foothills

north.description: To the north lies Rolling Foothills.

east.description: To the east lies Rolling Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies Wide Road Through the Foothills.

west.description: To the west lies Rolling Foothills.

105762.description:
A shallow dip in the foothills gathers the rain, and the grass is
greener and ankle-high around a small black pool. The water holds the
reflection of grey clouds and a few drifting leaves. Trampled trails
lead off in every direction, the southern one running down to the wide
road. The air smells of wet earth and distant smoke.

105763.name: Rolling Foothills

south.description: To the south lies Wide Road Through the Foothills.

west.description: To the west lies Rolling Foothills.

105763.description:
Tussocks of rust-coloured grass cover this knoll, which slopes down
south to the wide road. A tangle of gorse crowds a boulder streaked
white by birds, and the wind whistles through the spines. Further hills
ripple away in the haze, and not a tree breaks the skyline. The turf
leads on west over the rise.

105764.name: A Side Path

north.description: To the north lies A Side Path.

east.description: To the east lies Rolling Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies A Side Path.

105764.description:
The side path dips between banks of nettles and wild garlic, which scent
the air with a green pungency. Overhead a hawthorn hedge makes a loose
roof, hung with red berries. Ruts of a hay-cart show in the soft earth.
The path goes on north and south, and a gap leads east over the grass.

105765.name: Rolling Foothills

north.description: To the north lies Rolling Foothills.

east.description: To the east lies Rolling Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies Rolling Foothills.

west.description: To the west lies A Side Path.

105765.description:
Cart ruts and boot-prints crisscross this part of the hills, where the
road's traffic has spilled out into the heather. A signpost stands at a
crossing of tracks, but its arms have been snapped off and lie in the
weeds. A side path leaves west through the bracken, and the slope runs
on north, south and east.

105766.name: Rolling Foothills

north.description: To the north lies Rolling Foothills.

east.description: To the east lies Rolling Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies Rolling Foothills.

west.description: To the west lies Rolling Foothills.

105766.description:
Tumbled grey stones lie in the grass here, the remains of a field wall
whose builders gave up long ago. Thistles have claimed the gaps, and
their purple heads nod in the wind. Paths of beaten earth fork off
toward the other knolls, one climbing north, another falling south. A
low humming rises from bees in the heather.

105767.name: Rolling Foothills

south.description: To the south lies Rolling Foothills.

west.description: To the west lies Rolling Foothills.

105767.description:
The ground rises to a rounded crest where a single hawthorn clings to
the slope, its branches all leaning away from the hills. Sheep-tracks
cut through patches of heather and bracken, and the turf is cropped
short. The slope falls south toward the road and west toward more
rolling country. Smoke from some distant hearth smudges the horizon.

105768.name: Rolling Foothills

north.description: To the north lies Rolling Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies Rolling Foothills.

west.description: To the west lies Rolling Foothills.

105768.description:
The foothills fold themselves around a bowl of bracken, russet and
brittle at this season, that crackles as you pass. A dead oak stands on
the lip of the bowl, split by lightning and bleached white as a bone.
Tracks lead on north and west across the slopes, while south the ground
falls away toward more heather. High above, a lone hawk hangs in the
pale sky.

105769.name: Rolling Foothills

north.description: To the north lies Rolling Foothills.

east.description: To the east lies Rolling Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies Rolling Foothills.

west.description: To the west lies A Side Path.

105769.description:
A pair of ancient standing stones lean together at the brow of this
knoll, their faces pitted by centuries of rain. Lichen paints them in
patches of grey and orange. Beyond them the hills tumble away in all
directions. A narrow side path leads west, and the open slopes lead
north, east and south.

extra_descs.standing stones stones:
The two tall stones lean toward one another like old men whispering.
Faint spirals have been scratched into their faces by hands older than
the castle.

105770.name: A Side Path

north.description: To the north lies A Side Path.

east.description: To the east lies Rolling Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies A Side Path.

105770.description:
A rickety wooden gate, hanging from a single hinge, marks the beginning
of the farmland that once served the castle. Thin furrows of an
overgrown field run beside the path, where weeds have swallowed the old
crops. A rusting plough rests in the grass. The path runs north toward
the buildings and south back toward the castle, and a trail leaves east
over the knolls.

105771.name: A Side Path

north.description: To the north lies Barn.

east.description: To the east lies Rolling Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies A Side Path.

west.description: To the west lies Stable.

105771.description:
The path ends at a yard of beaten earth between a long, low barn and a
sagging stable. A stone trough, green with scum, stands by the barn
door. Ruts and old straw show that animals were once kept here. The barn
lies to the north and the stable to the west, with the path leading back
south and a trail east over the hills.

105772.name: Barn

south.description: To the south lies A Side Path.

105772.description:
The barn smells of mouldering hay and mice. Great cobwebbed beams hold
up a roof pierced by holes where daylight falls in grey bars. A wagon
with a broken axle rests against the wall, and loose straw covers the
floor in drifts. The big door opens south onto the yard.

105773.name: Rolling Foothills

north.description: To the north lies An Intersection In The King's Road.

east.description: To the east lies Rolling Foothills.

105773.description:
The hill slopes down toward a faint line of road, with the King's Road
crossing in the open country beyond. A track of beaten earth leads north
down to the intersection, and heather grows thick on either side. The
ground rises east toward a bluff. A patch of nettles marks the place
where an old waymark once stood.

105774.name: Stable

east.description: To the east lies A Side Path.

105774.description:
Wooden stalls line the walls of the stable, their half-doors splintered
and their iron rings rusted. The straw is old and dark, and a leather
halter hangs from a peg, cracked by time. The smell of horse is only a
ghost in the air. The only way out is the open doorway east.

105775.name: Rolling Foothills

north.description: To the north lies Rolling Foothills.

east.description: To the east lies Rolling Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies Rolling Foothills.

west.description: To the west lies A Side Path.

105775.description:
Wheel ruts run through the turf here, the broad marks of carts that once
came and went from the buildings along the side path. The grass at the
verge is trampled flat, and a few dry stalks of old hay lie scattered on
the ground. A rough path leads west toward a barn and stable, while the
slopes go on north, south and east.

105776.name: Rolling Foothills

north.description: To the north lies Rolling Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies Rolling Foothills.

west.description: To the west lies Rolling Foothills.

105776.description:
A drystone wall, half fallen, marches along the side of this hill and
then loses heart in a heap of mossy rubble. Yellow gorse flowers burn
bright among the stones, and their sweet coconut smell hangs in the air.
The grass is long and soft with dew. Trails lead north toward higher
ground, west over a rise, and south down the slope.

105777.name: Rolling Foothills

north.description: To the north lies Rolling Foothills.

east.description: To the east lies Rolling Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies Rolling Foothills.

105777.description:
Heather and gorse cover the slope in a tangle of purple and yellow,
thick enough to snag at your cloak. A scrap of faded cloth, caught on
the thorns, flutters like a tiny flag. Small birds scatter from the
bushes at your approach. The hillside tilts south, and the ground opens
out north and east.

105778.name: Rolling Foothills

north.description: To the north lies Rolling Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies Rolling Foothills.

west.description: To the west lies Rolling Foothills.

105778.description:
From this height the land lies open in every direction, ridge after
ridge of brown hills fading into blue. A flat-topped boulder makes a
natural seat and is worn smooth by shepherds. The wind is stronger here
and carries the cry of curlews. North the ground climbs on, south it
drops, and a faint trail wanders west.

105779.name: Rolling Foothills

east.description: To the east lies Rolling Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies Rolling Foothills.

west.description: To the west lies Rolling Foothills.

105779.description:
A small stream, dry in summer and now a mere thread of silver, winds
through this hollow between two knolls. Willow scrub grows along its
stony bed, rattling its last yellow leaves. The footing is soft and the
grass is trampled by hoofs, though the tracks are old. The hollow opens
east to a bluff, south over the slope, and west toward lower ground.

105780.name: Rolling Foothills

south.description: To the south lies Rolling Foothills.

west.description: To the west lies Rolling Foothills.

105780.description:
The hill ends in a bluff of crumbling earth and exposed roots, where the
foothills seem to lean against the sky. A scatter of fallen stones marks
where some old beacon or watchpost once stood. Dry thyme crushes under
your boots and perfumes the wind. The bluff slopes south, and a track
leads west along its edge.

105781.name: Wide Road Through the Foothills

north.description: To the north lies Rolling Foothills.

east.description: To the east lies Wide Road Through the Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies The Rolling Foothills.

west.description: To the west lies Wide Road Through the Foothills.

105781.description:
The wide road is paved here with flat grey slabs, cracked and furred
with moss, the work of a more prosperous age. Deep ruts run between the
verges, filled with last night's rain. A hillside rises to the north,
and to the south the ground falls to a bowl of tussocky grass. The road
runs on east and west, and a lone crow watches from a fence post.

105782.name: Wide Road Through the Foothills

north.description: To the north lies Rolling Foothills.

east.description: To the east lies Wide Road Through the Foothills.

south.description: To the south lies The Rolling Foothills.

west.description: To the west lies Entrance to Castle Varok.

105782.description:
The wide road curves here toward a great gatehouse, and the castle's
outer wall rises in dark blocks beside the verge. Ivy has strangled one
corner tower, and its leaves rustle like whispers. Iron lanterns hang on
poles along the roadside, long dark. The entrance to Castle Varok lies
just west, and paths lead north and south over the turf.

105783.name: Cold Storage

north.description: To the north lies Kitchen.

105783.description:
Cold seeps from the stone walls of this cellar, where rows of slate
shelves hold dusty jars and bottles sealed with wax. Hooks for hanging
meat gleam in the roof, rusted and bare. Barrels of vinegar and brine
leak into puddles along the floor. The air is dank and still. The only
way out is north to the kitchen.

645800.name: wolf grey hill hungry
645800.long_desc: A gaunt grey wolf prowls the slope, its ribs showing and its eyes burning red.
645800.description:
The wolf's coat is patchy and dull, and its eyes glow with an unnatural
red light. It trails the castle road as if called by something unseen.
Its lips draw back from yellow teeth.

645801.name: skeleton servant bone retainer
645801.long_desc: A skeletal servant in the rags of livery shuffles through the hall, a dust-cloth still clutched in its fingers.
645801.description:
The skeleton still wears the tattered black and silver livery of the
Varok household. Its jaw clacks as it turns its empty sockets on you. It
moves with a rote precision, as if it never noticed its death.

645802.name: ghost dancer ballroom spectre
645802.long_desc: A waltzing ghost in a gown of mist turns slowly in the arms of an unseen partner.
645802.description:
The ghost's features blur, though a dark gown and powdered hair can be
made out. It dances to music that no living ear can hear. Its cold eyes
follow you as it spins.

645803.name: vampire spawn pale fanged
645803.long_desc: A pale vampire spawn crouches in the shadows, its fangs bared and its eyes hungry.
645803.description:
This gaunt creature was once a guest of the castle and now serves the
Varoks in death. Its skin is white as candle-wax and its nails have
grown into claws. It moves in swift, wolfish bounds.

645804.name: gargoyle stone winged
645804.long_desc: A stone gargoyle perches motionless above the doorway, its granite wings folded.
645804.description:
Carved from black granite, the gargoyle has bat-like wings, curved horns
and a gaping, grinning mouth. When it moves, stone grinds on stone. Its
eyes are two points of red light.

645805.name: lady seraphine varok vampire
645805.long_desc: Lady Seraphine Varok, a vampire in a gown of midnight silk, glides across the floor of the ballroom.
645805.description:
Lady Seraphine is tall and breathtaking, with skin like ivory and hair
like a spill of ink. Her smile shows the tips of her fangs. She moves
with the grace of a dancer who has had centuries to practise.

645806.name: lord aldric varok vampire
645806.long_desc: Lord Aldric Varok, a vampire of terrible age, stands beside the canopied bed, his cold eyes on you.
645806.description:
Lord Varok is a tall, gaunt figure in a black coat trimmed with silver,
his face an aristocrat's mask of cold contempt. His eyes are the red of
old wine. The room seems to grow darker as he moves.

745800.name: dagger fang black varok
745800.room_desc: A narrow black dagger shaped like a fang lies here.
745800.description: Its blade is dark steel, curved like a canine tooth, and the hilt is wrapped in black silk. It is cold as the grave to the touch.

745801.name: ring signet varok silver
745801.room_desc: A heavy silver signet ring lies here.
745801.description: A silver ring bearing a bat-winged crest, worn smooth by centuries of use. It is always a little colder than the hand that wears it.

745802.name: gown midnight silk lady
745802.room_desc: A gown of midnight-blue silk lies here.
745802.description: A gown cut for a lady of rank, woven from silk so dark it seems to drink the light. A few silver threads shine at the hem.

745803.name: halberd tarnished castle
745803.description: The axe-head is dull with age, but the edge still bites. The haft is carved with the crest of the Varoks.

745804.name: pelt wolf grey
745804.room_desc: A thick grey wolf pelt lies here.
745804.description: A heavy pelt of coarse grey fur, strangely cold. A furrier in Garathorm would pay well for it.
